name: Direlands: Extraction
storyline:
Aurelanth was a world without death. Its lifestones raised the fallen and gave powerful magic to the inhabitants. Until a powerful force became aware of this power and tried to tear it out of the world, but the world tore apart instead.

What remains is the Direlands, a graveyard of floating fragments where each shard has been sealed off and alone for an age. Some were overrun by monsters. Some went mad. Scattered among them lies the broken power of the lifestones, held by the strongest things that survived.

On the ruins of a mages' Academy, the last of Aurelanth's mages have done the impossible and opened a rift across the void. Mistakenly, you were pulled through this rift from another world into this one. You have the choice to help rebuild and reconnect the remains of Aurelanth by traveling to undiscovered shards, defeating powerful enemies that are guarding splinters that allow further shards to be traveled to.
summary:
Direlands: Extraction blends the chase of a looter shooter, the tension of extraction gameplay, and the depth of classic fantasy RPGs.

The Direlands are a fractured world, torn apart by ancient magical forces. Travel between distant realms is only possible through powerful portal networks, allowing adventurers to brave forgotten ruins, cursed wildernesses, and lost civilizations in search of treasure and power.

But every journey carries risk. Gather valuable loot, uncover ancient secrets, and grow stronger with each expedition—but make it back alive. Death in the Direlands means losing everything you carried with you, leaving only your hard-earned knowledge and experience behind.
